extension.summary: Fetches game manuals from the REG-Vault catalogue
extension.description:
Looks up the games in your sources by ROM hash and downloads the manuals the REG-Vault catalogue holds for them, so that Kodi's manual viewer can show them.
Matching is exact: a game is found by the hash of the ROM itself, so a manual is either the right one or it is not offered. A ROM that is a different dump, region or revision to anything catalogued simply will not be found.
Manuals remain the copyright of their publishers. REG-Vault catalogues them as a preservation archive.
